quotes.text: If `GCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` is set then `ginkgo-e2e.sh` sets `--gce-service-account=$GCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT`, which causes tests to use the metadata server for the account, which we do not want.
quotes.author: fejta
quotes.title: Do not depend on metadata server for auth

medium: The code avoids metadata server authentication due to issues causing test failures and requiring explicit service account injection.

answer: Soak tests rely on the GCE service account path; removing it caused 'invalid grant' errors.
